description: A young woman with long braids tied up in a bun and a mustard jumper bends close over a detailed model village on a table. With a thin needle and steady fingers she fixes a tiny part onto a thatched stone cottage, while a tube of glue lies on a green cutting mat beside a small matchbox. Three young women sit by a tall window with a view of a church and watch quietly. Then she jumps up and cheers with both fists, and a laughing young man in a denim jacket leans in beside the table.
